item.title: 🇷🇺 🚨 RUSSIA: 5.7 MILLION VK USER RECORDS ALLEGEDLY OFFERED FOR SALE A threat actor on an underground forum is advertising a "5.7 Million VK[....
item.description:
🇷🇺 🚨 RUSSIA: 5.7 MILLION VK USER RECORDS ALLEGEDLY OFFERED FOR SALE

A threat actor on an underground forum is advertising a "5.7 Million VK[.]com User Database", allegedly tied to Russia's largest social network.

The sample in the listing shows:
* VK profile links (numeric user IDs)
* Phone numbers
* Full names

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
VK user data has turned up again and again in past leak compilations and scraped datasets. This listing is tagged "2023", was posted in an "unverified sellers" section and comes from a seller who brands themselves around phone-number databases. Treat it as possibly recycled or scraped/enriched data rather than a fresh VK breach. No email addresses or passwords are shown, and the price, freshness and real volume are unclear. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that VK systems were compromised. Name-to-phone mappings are still useful for SIM-swap targeting, scam calls and messenger phishing.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Russia #VK #DataLeak #SocialMedia #ThreatIntelligence #CyberSecurity

VIDEO | Delhi: Reacting to Rahul Gandhi’s ‘X’ post replying to Elon Musk, BJP leader Sidharth Yadav says, “Rahul Gandhi’s politics is now dependent on foreign powers. Sometimes, he goes to London and says that complaints should be made about Indian democracy. At other times, he goes to the United States and talks about interference in Indian democracy. Sometimes, he stands in his own office and says, ‘We have to fight the Indian State itself’. We want to make one thing absolutely clear to Rahul Gandhi: India is a sovereign nation. India’s policies are made in the Indian Parliament, not on X. The Government of India will take decisions based on what is in the best interests of the people of this country. But until a year ago, the Congress party itself used to speak out against Starlink. What has changed today that the party has started speaking in its favour?”

STORY | Railways cancels select Mail, Express trains arriving at New Delhi, Nizamuddin stations on Oct 10

The Railway Board on Friday cancelled certain Mail and Express trains scheduled to arrive at New Delhi and Hazrat Nizamuddin stations between 4 am and 2 pm on October 10.

According to a circular, trains departing from their originating stations after 2 pm on October 9 and scheduled to arrive at New Delhi or Hazrat Nizamuddin stations between 4 am and 2 pm on October 10 will be cancelled at their originating stations.

"All Mail/Express trains starting at source after 14:00 Hrs today, i.e., 9th Oct which are reaching New Delhi, Hazrat Nizamuddin Railway Station, on 10th October from 04:00 to 14:00 hrs, are to be cancelled at the source," the circular read.

The Railways cited unexpected road traffic between the two stations as the reason for the cancellations.

The Cockroach Janata Party has announced a protest at Jantar Mantar on Saturday, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

The city police have urged the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) to shut 57 metro stations to scupper the movement of youths who may be coming to join the protest

item.title: 🇫🇷 🚨 FRANCE: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS 71K-RECORD SCOUTS MEMBER DATABASE, LIKELY INCLUDING MINORS A threat actor on an underground forum has posted...
item.description:
🇫🇷 🚨 FRANCE: THREAT ACTOR CLAIMS 71K-RECORD SCOUTS MEMBER DATABASE, LIKELY INCLUDING MINORS

A threat actor on an underground forum has posted what they claim is a 71,000-record member database of the "Association des scouts de France", releasing it for a token amount of forum credits.

The field list shown in the post includes:
* Member identity: civil status, names, member code, date and place of birth
* Home addresses, phone numbers and personal/professional emails
* Family-allowance (CAF) number, profession and membership/fee details
* Consents: image rights, surgical-intervention authorisation, newsletters
* Up to three legal representatives per member, with their names, addresses, phones and emails
* Youth-leader training records (BAFA, Jeunesse et Sports)

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The legal-representative and medical-consent fields strongly suggest records of minors and their parents, which makes this one of the most sensitive kinds of data a youth organisation holds. The sample in the post refers to Scouts et Guides de France training. That points to the movement's member-management system or an export of it, but the exact source, freshness and true volume are unclear. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that the association's systems were breached.

🧒 Child-safety note: because the data likely concerns children, we have fully blacked out the sample record. If genuine, families face targeted phishing, fake membership-fee or camp-payment requests and impersonation of scout leaders. Parents should verify any unexpected contact through official scout channels.

VIDEO | Ranchi, Jharkhand: From a school bus driver's son to India's nets, Rajandeep dreams of following Dhoni, Ishan.

While India's star-studded top order was sending balls flying into the stands at the JSCA Stadium here on Thursday, another Jharkhand cricketer quietly made the most of his moment in the nets during their practice on the eve of the second T20I in Ranchi.

From a distance, 24-year-old Rajandeep Singh looked like Arshdeep Singh, but a closer look revealed another Jharkhand fast-bowling prospect making his mark.

With Ishan Kishan, Sanju Samson, Tilak Varma and 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi taking turns at the nets, Rajandeep bowled with confidence and discipline, occasionally beating the bat and drawing edges and miscued shots and also earning praise from them.

For a youngster from Jharkhand who once came close to giving up cricket because of financial difficulties, sharing the nets with India's leading T20 batters was a moment to cherish.

"I received an opportunity to bowl to the senior players. I realised what I could do better and what are the crucial things I need to work on. I also understood that I can't bowl too loose. It was a good feeling to bowl today," he said.
